subject: Request: Admin activity records & extraction format for SOC 2 evidence (Jul-Sep 2026)
messages:
From: Anna Langley <anna.langley@acme-corp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: jarod.reyes@cygnus-consulting.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Admin activity logs for SOC 2 audit (Jul-Sep 2026)

Hi Evelyn,

ACME is collecting evidence for our SOC 2 Type II scope and our auditor (Cygnus) has asked for a copy of Redwood's admin activity records for the period Jul 1, 2026 — Sep 30, 2026. Specifically we need:

- A full extract containing admin-level actions (user creation/deletion, role/permission changes, API key events, console login attempts/success/failure, MFA changes, service account usage).
- Timestamps in UTC and clearly documented timezone handling.
- Preferred formats: Parquet or CSV; compression OK. Please include a schema or data dictionary.
- Evidence of retention policy and chain-of-custody (checksums, file manifest, signed statement if possible).
- Export delivery: presigned S3 link or SFTP; if there are stricter alternatives (encrypted transfer, audited DLP path), let us know.

Can you confirm what fields are present, retention default, and an ETA for a production-ready export? The auditor will also want to know whether IP addresses and session IDs are included and how PII is handled.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Langley
InfoSec Manager, ACME Corp
anna.langley@acme-corp.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Anna Langley <anna.langley@acme-corp.com>
Cc: jarod.reyes@cygnus-consulting.com, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Admin activity logs for SOC 2 audit (Jul-Sep 2026)

Hi Anna / Jarod —

Thanks for the request. We can provide the admin activity evidence you described. High-level answers below and I attached a short schema document (redwood_admin_activity_schema.md).

What we log (summary):
- admin_user, actor_type (human/service_account), action_type (create/delete/update/authorize/revoke), target_resource, timestamp_utc, ip_address (trimmed by default), user_agent, request_id, source (console|api|internal), session_id, outcome (success|failure), change_summary, audit_event_id
- Separate audit for RBAC changes, IAM policy updates, and org-level config edits.

Retention and export options:
- Default retention for admin activity in Hosted: 365 days; Dedicated/Private can be configured longer or WORM-enabled on request.
- Exports: parquet (preferred for schema integrity), CSV with header, or raw JSONL. Delivery via presigned S3 link (configurable expiry), secure SFTP push, or direct transfer to a customer-managed bucket with cross-account role.
- Chain-of-custody: we provide a manifest, per-file checksums (SHA256), and an operator-signed statement.

PII and redaction:
- IPs are partially masked by default (last octet redacted). We can provide full IPs under a secured process with an approved DPA amendment or auditor NDA.

Next steps / ETA:
1) I'll loop in our infra team to produce the Parquet extracts and manifest.
2) Please confirm the delivery method (presigned S3 link vs SFTP) and whether you require full IP addresses.
3) Target: 48–72 hours for an initial export after confirmation.

Monica (CS) — can you coordinate the delivery preferences with ACME and track the request?

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: Admin activity logs for SOC 2 audit (ACME) — please prepare extracts

Dev — forwarding ACME's ask. They want Jul 1–Sep 30 2026 admin activity records in Parquet (preferred). Please prepare:

- Parquet extract with schema in attached redwood_admin_activity_schema.md.
- Generate manifest with SHA256 for each file and a top-level manifest.json (include event_count, first_timestamp, last_timestamp).
- Provide a presigned S3 link (48h) and an alternate SFTP drop. Also include a signed operator statement (I will sign).
- Note retention: hosted default 365 days; confirm we can export the full requested window (should be available).

Attach the file to the reply to ACME once ready; Temp creds / presigned link only — do not send as email attachment. Reach out if you hit any rate-limit/permission edge cases.

Thanks,
Evelyn
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Admin activity logs for SOC 2 audit (ACME) — extracts ready for delivery

Evelyn / Monica —

Quick technical summary of what I've prepared and attached: admin_extract_jul-sep-2026.parquet (split into 3 files, compressed), plus export_instructions_presigned_s3.txt.

What the Parquet contains (fields):
- audit_event_id (uuid), timestamp_utc (ISO8601), admin_user, actor_type, action_type, target_resource, change_summary, request_id, session_id, ip_address_masked, user_agent, outcome, source, region, storage_bucket, file_path

Notes / decisions:
- IP handling: masked as xxx.xxx.xxx.0 in Hosted by default. We can provide full IPs if ACME confirms via DPA addendum or auditor NDA.
- Timestamps: normalized to UTC.
- Compression: Snappy.
- Manifest: admin_extract_manifest_sha256.txt included; top-level checksums: file1.parquet (sha256: abc...), file2.parquet (sha256: def...), file3.parquet (sha256: 123...).
- Delivery: creating presigned S3 URLs — will paste into a secure ticket comment and send ACME the ticket link (we also have an option to push via SFTP). Presigned links expire in 48h by default (configurable).
- Retention confirmation: hosted retention window (365 days) preserved; requested window is available from our archive store; no data loss expected.

Attachments: admin_extract_jul-sep-2026.parquet, admin_extract_manifest_sha256.txt, export_instructions_presigned_s3.txt

If ACME requires signed operator verification, Evelyn — ping me and I will compile the export logs and sign-off block.

— Dev
From: Anna Langley <anna.langley@acme-corp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: jarod.reyes@cygnus-consulting.com
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Admin activity logs for SOC 2 audit (Jul-Sep 2026)

Evelyn / Dev —

Thank you for the quick turnaround and the attached schema. Parquet is fine — ACME prefers Parquet with a manifest and SHA256 checksums. A few follow-ups before we close this out:

- Please provide the SHA256 checksums in the ticket and the MD5 (if available) so our ingestion pipeline can validate.
- We confirm we do need full IP addresses for audit correlation. Per your note we will execute the DPA addendum / auditor NDA — can you send the required contact point?
- We also need a written statement that the extract reflects raw audit records (no behavioral sampling) and the time range is complete. A signed operator statement is sufficient.

If you can provide the presigned S3 URLs and manifest (and the signed statement) in the next 24 hours that would meet our audit timeline.

Regards,
Anna
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Anna Langley <anna.langley@acme-corp.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Anna —

We will:
1) Upload the Parquet files and manifest to a secure Redwood S3 bucket and provide presigned links (48h).
2) Attach SHA256 checksums in the ticket and include MD5 where available.
3) Produce a signed operator statement confirming the extract is raw audit data covering 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30 and that no sampling/filtering was applied.
4) For full IPs: please route the DPA addendum/NDA through legal@redwood.com; once signed we will replace the masked IPs with full addresses and provide a new set of files.

Target: presigned links + manifest + signed statement within 24 hours.

Evelyn
